title: Lightly Spicy Jamaican Shrimp Skewers
description: Quick-fix Jamaican dish featuring red chilli, umami flavors and silky shrimp, perfect for a pescatarian-friendly meal.
instructions: Preheat the air fryer to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together soy sauce, brown sugar, thyme, allspice, salt, and black pepper.
Add the diced red chilli, scotch bonnet pepper, and minced garlic to the bowl and stir to combine.
Add the peeled and deveined shrimp to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated shrimp onto skewers, leaving a small space between each shrimp.
Brush the skewers with olive oil and place them in the air fryer basket.
Cook the shrimp skewers in the air fryer for 8-10 minutes, or until they are pink and cooked through.
Serve the shrimp skewers hot, garnished with additional thyme and scotch bonnet pepper if desired.
